page.notes: Running head "LIBER II." and page number 199 read from the top of the page. Signature "N 4" at foot right. No catchword is printed. Doubtful readings: "siid" (printed as fiid, read as si id); "rat.II." (printed as i r, read as II for Cicero, De Oratore lib. II); the Greek word after "Aristoteles" is uncertain (read as ἀποδείξιν, the expected sense "demonstration"); "&inuentum" might carry a printed point; "suppressam" is a doubtful reading of "fupreffam". The line ends "patefa-" and continues on the next page.
